flags.reason: The guide was checked on 28 October on the installed build (0.1.78-dbe0e02) for #394 and #346, but three of its sentences describe the bubble before the #395 fixes that dbe0e02 also carries, and the entry leaves them out. States: “Its default name is the description and the status word, with no amount or date, so set accessibilityLabel.” The installed bubble's default name is the description, the amount with its currency, the status and the date (“Paid to Priya Sharma, ₹1,200, Paid, 21 Oct 2026”), or the slot's words when statusSlot is set (TransactionBubble.tsx lines 110–144, 242–250). Sources: “its description is Regular where Figma’s is Medium, and its default accessible name leaves out the amount and date”; the description now reads its 500 weight token, Medium like Figma (198–202, 226). Configuration: “No other mode changes the bubble.”; the package's tokens say otherwise: Page type JioPlus turns the amount and the chevron white, context 10 jioPlus and context5 turn the chevron white, and Context2 AppBar and NavArrow Direction resize or turn it. The Content advice to set accessibilityLabel on a pressable bubble is kept. The guide fix belongs to #395 (open; a work note there lists these sentences). Re-extract once #395 is closed and the guide is re-checked and published. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch11, for Marcin to confirm.

examples.purpose: Payments in a thread, the guide's In context: the payment you sent sits on the right and the request you received on the left, each 231 px wide as in Figma, with the Transaction Status mode that goes with its word and an accessibilityLabel with the person, the amount, the status and the date. Each onPress opens that payment's details; the empty functions stand for that wiring.
examples.jsx:
<VStack>
  <TransactionBubble
    style={{ width: 231, maxWidth: '100%', alignSelf: 'flex-end' }}
    description="Paid to Priya Sharma"
    value="1,200"
    status="Paid"
    date="21 Oct 2026"
    modes={{ 'Transaction Status': 'Paid' }}
    onPress={() => {}}
    accessibilityLabel="Paid to Priya Sharma, ₹1,200, paid 21 Oct 2026"
  />
  <TransactionBubble
    style={{ width: 231, maxWidth: '100%', alignSelf: 'flex-start' }}
    description="Request from Priya Sharma"
    value="450"
    status="Requested"
    date="Today"
    modes={{ 'Transaction Status': 'Request' }}
    onPress={() => {}}
    accessibilityLabel="Request from Priya Sharma, ₹450, requested today"
  />
</VStack>

props.name: description
props.description: Default "Payment to Uber India", from the component source.

props.name: value
props.description: Shown by a MoneyValue. The amount is announced once, as an image named with the currency and the digits (“₹1,200”); the visible ₹ and digits are hidden from screen readers. Declared: Default "56", from the component source.

props.name: currency
props.description: Defaults to ₹; ISO codes such as INR show their symbol. The amount is drawn at the bubble's size: ₹ 28 px, digits 26 px, weight 900. Declared: Default "₹", from the component source.

props.name: status
props.description: The status line stays on one line: in a 231 px bubble a long status and date end in an ellipsis, and the chevron stays inside.

props.name: date
props.description: Default "20 Mar 2025", from the component source.

props.name: statusSlot
props.description: Replaces the whole status row, chevron included; what it holds gets the bubble's modes. Declared: Slot for the status area. When provided, replaces the default TransactionStatus + NavArrow.

props.name: children
props.description: Rendered between the amount and the status row, with the bubble's modes (a child's own modes win).

props.name: onPress
props.description: Makes the root a Pressable button, at opacity 0.85 while pressed.

props.name: style
props.description: Goes after the container style. The bubble sets no width: it fills its host.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: When `true`, disables text truncation: the trailing ellipsis (`…`) is never shown and any `numberOfLines` clamp is ignored, so the text wraps to as many lines as it needs even when horizontal space is tight.

props.name: ...Omit<PressableProps, 'style' | 'children' | 'onPress'>
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

gaps.text: The bubble is 119 px tall with one line of description where Figma's is 109, because the amount sits on a 34 px line.
Figma's bubble is a fixed 231 px wide; the package's fills its host.
In the published Storybook, the Successful story keeps the orange mark and the slot story shows two amounts (reported).
